blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday expressed belief that China is also leaning towards the finalization of the Code of Conduct (COC) in the South China Sea, citing his recent conversation with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi. Speaking at a press briefing before departing for Manila, Marcos said he had a lengthy discussion with Wang during the gala dinner of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting. “I had an opportunity during the gala dinner, quite by coincidence, or maybe by design, I don’t know, to sit next to Foreign Minister Wang Yi.
